Contact Us FAQ System & Hardware What is VuDrive, and how does it work? VuDrive is an advanced driver monitoring and fleet management system that helps improve safety, detect risky behavior, and optimize operations using real-time video analytics and telematics data. Learn more → How do I install the VuDrive hardware? To install your new VuDrive device, follow our step-by-step guide, starting here → Do I need a professional to install the device? No. Anyone can follow our step-by-step guide, starting here → What happens if the device is disconnected? The system will stop reporting data, and a red flashing LED light will indicate that the device is no longer connected. At this point, you should try and drive to a different location that might have a stronger signal and make sure that there is a SIM card inserted in the device. Can VuDrive be used in electric or hybrid vehicles? Yes, VuDrive supports electric and hybrid vehicles. What cameras or sensors are included with VuDrive? VuDrive includes an in-cabin camera for driver monitoring and a road-facing camera to capture safety events. The device also includes an accelerometer and gyro for precise driving behavior monitoring. How do I reset or troubleshoot the VuDrive hardware? To reset the VuDrive device, insert a pin into the reset button slot located on the top of the device, just beneath the cable entrance cap. This will reboot the device without erasing any configuration settings. If issues continue after the reset, contact support for further troubleshooting assistance. Driver Monitoring What behaviors does VuDrive detect? VuDrive detects Distraction, Eyes off the road, phone usage, smoking, camera Blockage, and seatbelt violation (depending on the model) using AI. It also detects harsh braking, acceleration, and cornering using a G-sensor. Does VuDrive record video? If yes, how is the video stored? Yes. VuDrive records video in two main ways: – Event-Triggered Clips : When a safety event occurs (e.g., harsh braking or sudden turns), a short video clip is automatically saved to the SD card and uploaded to the cloud. – Full Trip Video Playback : Even if no events were triggered, you can access video recordings of full trips. These are available on demand under the “Video” tab of the trip page and are segmented into 10-minute intervals . How is driver distraction detected? Using facial recognition and head pose estimation algorithms via the in-cabin camera. What happens if a driver is detected as drowsy or distracted? An audible alert is issued in real time. Events are also logged for later review. Is the system compliant with privacy regulations? Yes. VuDrive complies with relevant privacy regulations. Feel free to browse our privacy policy here . Web Platform & Mobile App How do I log in to the VuDrive platform? Go to https://vudrive.net/ and enter your username and password. Go to https://vudrive.net/ Click on Forgot Password and then enter your email. You will receive an email with a link to reset your password. WinDriver provides a uniform API across operating systems, allowing you to write your device logic once and compile it for each supported OS. The same application and driver logic can be reused, significantly reducing development time and maintenance effort. WinDriver handles the OS-specific kernel interaction layer, including support for PCI/PCIe/SoC and USB devices, DMA, and interrupts. This approach enables true cross-platform driver development without rewriting your driver separately for each operating system. Enabling legacy PCI configuration space read/write for identifying PCI devices on Windows + In version 6.2.0 of WinDriver, the PCI configuration space read/write method on Windows was upgraded to a more advanced method. On rare occasions, this method fails to identify some PCI devices.
